name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
January 28, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Father Michael Carr of All Saints’ Episcopal Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring January 28, 2014, "Huntington Wozniak Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of receiving the World Waterpark Association Emerging Leaders Employee of the Year Award.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Unscheduled Vacancies on the Central Vista Business Improvement District Advisory Board (CVBID) (CC)
C4.
Vacation of Public Street and Acquisition of Right of Way at 210 S. Melrose Drive (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving and authorizing the Mayor to execute a public street and utility easement acquisition agreement.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving and authorizing the summary vacation.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving and authorizing the City Manager to summarily vacate and execute a quitclaim deed to Vista Gas, LLC.
C5.
First Amendment to Design/Build Agreement for the Agua Hedionda Lift Station Emergency Bypass Pump Project (CC)
C6.
Agreement with Keh & Associates, Inc. for the Design of the West Vista Way Phase I Sewer Project - CIP No. 8077 (CC)
C7.
State Route 78 at Sycamore Eastbound Off-Ramp Improvement Project - CIP No. 8107 (CC)
C8.
Agreement for Next Generation Regional Communication System (NextGen RCS) (CC)
DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
General Plan Amendment and Zone Change at 1806 E. Vista Way (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendments to the General Plan. (Recommended Action continued on following page)
(Recommended Action continued from previous page)
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , approving an amendment to rezone from Medium High Density Residential (MHD) to Commercial Neighborhood (CN); and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving a Zone Change from Multi-Residential with a Maximum Density of 15 Units Per Acre (R-M(15)) to Commercial (C-1) at 1806 E. Vista Way."
PH2.
Amendment to Specific Plan No. 14
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendments to Specific Plan No. 14; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving an Amendment to Specific Plan No. 14."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
